owner_remarks: Great city car; light steering and easy to park.
The CVT is smooth but feels lazy on highway overtakes.
ASA (Advanced Safety Assist) works well for the price.
Fuel economy is excellent for daily commuting.
history: The third-generation Myvi (G3) launched in late 2017 and was facelifted in 2021. It is Malaysia's best-selling car and is developed by Perodua, which is majority-owned by Daihatsu and UMW, giving it strong Toyota/Daihatsu engineering heritage.

owner_remarks: Best value A-segment sedan; surprisingly spacious boot.
The 4AT is dated but reliable and cheap to maintain.
Ride comfort is good for the price; engine is a bit noisy at speed.
Spare parts are everywhere in Malaysia - cheap to own.
history: The Saga is Proton's first and longest-running model, originally launched in 1985 based on the Mitsubishi Lancer Fiore. The 2019 facelift brought Proton's new design language under Geely ownership and a new VVT engine.

owner_remarks: The 1.5T is punchy and efficient; the CVT is one of the better ones.
Spacious cabin with a low seating position.
Watch for the CVT fluid change interval; keep it maintained.
Handling is sharper than previous generations.
history: The tenth-generation Civic (FC) launched globally in 2016 with a new turbocharged engine line-up and aggressive fastback styling. It has a strong enthusiast following and is a popular modding platform in Malaysia.

owner_remarks: A rally-bred pocket rocket; the AWD grip is phenomenal.
Very stiff ride - it is a focused performance car, not a commuter.
Manual gearbox and rev-matching are excellent.
Expensive for its size but nothing else drives like it at the price.
history: The GR Yaris is Toyota's homologation special developed with its WRC team (now Toyota Gazoo Racing), with a bespoke body, carbon-fibre roof, and a rally-derived AWD system. It was built to revive Toyota's performance image under the GR brand.
